target.statement: DFNMF achieves Q=0.591 and B=0.162 on DrugNet with k=5 (Table III, row DFNMF, columns DrugNet k=5)

compute.basis: DrugNet has only 293 nodes and 284 edges; the method uses sparse matrix operations and converges in ~150 iterations, so a CPU run should take seconds to a few minutes per seed, plus data download and setup.

blockers: Code repository may be incomplete or outdated (only a GitHub link is provided; no explicit data/configs in the paper).
DrugNet dataset is not directly linked in the paper; it must be obtained from a public source (e.g., the original fair clustering benchmark).
title: A Deep Latent Factor Graph Clustering with Fairness-Utility Trade-off Perspective
